behavior: Usually remains low in dense cover, walking or climbing through vegetation and making short flights when flushed. Forages on mud, at water edges, and in shallow water, picking seeds and invertebrates from the ground, plants, or water surface. Males sing a simple trill from raised perches.
field_marks: Compact, robust sparrow with a moderately long, rounded tail
Short conical bill with a yellowish base
Rusty crown in breeding plumage; browner and streaked outside the breeding season
Gray face with a dark eye and dark line behind it; clean whitish throat
Rusty-chestnut wings and back marked with dark streaks
habitat: Densely vegetated wetlands, especially freshwater marshes, sedge swamps, bogs, wet meadows, and brushy margins with cattails, reeds, grasses, or shrubs. Also uses brackish marshes; during migration and winter it may occur in damp thickets, streamside cover, and weedy fields.
